channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan recognizes 3,861 people, including 99 foreign nationals, in autumn honors
item.description: Among recipients of the honors, set to be awarded at ceremonies including the Imperial Palace in Tokyo, 400 are women, accounting for 10.4%.

item.title: Ceremony held for recipients of Japan’s Order of Culture
item.description: The government announced the names of the eight awardees, including Nobel laureate Kenso Soai and Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto, last month.

item.title: As Japan marks 80 years of Constitution, debate continues on emergency clause
item.description: Some experts argue such a clause is needed for swift initial responses to disasters, while others worry it could lead to concentrated authority.

item.title: Second Japanese national confirmed dead in Spanish train crash
item.description: Spanish authorities have identified all 69 people killed in a high-speed train collision in central Spain last week.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
